chapters.name: Real Numbers
chapters.summary: Apply Euclid's Division Algorithm to find HCF of any two positive integers Explain the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and use it to find LCM and HCF

chapters.name: Polynomials
chapters.summary: Determine the degree, zeroes, and coefficients of any polynomial Apply the Remainder Theorem to find remainders without long division

chapters.name: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
chapters.summary: Solve systems of linear equations using graphical, substitution, and elimination methods Determine whether a system is consistent, inconsistent, or dependent

topics.name: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

chapters.name: Quadratic Equations
chapters.summary: Identify quadratic equations in standard form ax² + bx + c = 0 Solve quadratic equations by factorization, completing the square, and quadratic formula

chapters.name: Arithmetic Progressions
chapters.summary: Identify arithmetic progressions (AP) from given sequences Find the nth term of an AP using aₙ = a + (n-1)d

chapters.name: Coordinate Geometry
chapters.summary: Apply the distance formula to find distance between any two points in the coordinate plane Use the section formula to find the coordinates of a point dividing a line segment in a given ratio

chapters.name: Triangles
chapters.summary: Apply the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem) and its converse to solve problems Prove and apply AA, SSS, SAS similarity criteria for triangles

chapters.name: Circles
chapters.summary: Define a tangent to a circle and prove its uniqueness at a point Prove and apply the Tangent-Radius perpendicular theorem

chapters.name: Introduction to Trigonometry
chapters.summary: Define and calculate the six trigonometric ratios (sin, cos, tan, cosec, sec, cot) for acute angles Use trigonometric tables and standard angle values (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) to solve problems

chapters.name: Constructions
chapters.summary: Formal construction of similar triangles and tangents using ruler and compass.

chapters.name: Some Applications of Trigonometry
chapters.summary: Define angles of elevation and depression and identify them in real-world scenarios Apply trigonometric ratios to solve height and distance problems

chapters.name: Areas Related to Circles
chapters.summary: Calculate the area of a circle, sector, and segment of a circle with precision Apply formulas for combinations of plane figures involving circles, squares, rectangles, and triangles

chapters.name: Surface Areas and Volumes
chapters.summary: Calculate the total surface area and volume of combinations of solids (cuboid, cylinder, cone, sphere, hemisphere) Solve problems involving conversion of solids from one shape to another (e.g., sphere melted into cylinders)

chapters.name: Statistics
chapters.summary: Calculate the mean of grouped data using direct, assumed mean, and step-deviation methods Determine the mode of grouped data using the modal class formula

chapters.name: Probability
chapters.summary: Define probability as P(E) = n(E)/n(S) and apply it to simple events Distinguish between experimental and theoretical probability
